sealed_candidate.answer: **Decision: The build agent may open a pull request once tests pass; it may not deploy to production on its own authority.** Per the governing policy, production deployment requires approval by the service owner and a recorded rollback plan [delivery-policy]. The sandbox experiment that permitted automatic deployment applied only to disposable test environments and did not authorize production deployment [delivery-context].
